scope: finite-union-bound closure for almost-sure extension axioms
core_statement: If Gamma is a finite subset of T_ext and every extension axiom is almost sure, then Pr[A_n models Gamma] tends to 1.
proof_surface: for every gamma in Gamma, Pr[A_n does not model gamma] tends to 0
A_n does not model Gamma implies A_n does not model gamma for some gamma in Gamma
union bound controls the finite disjunction
finite sum of null-limit error terms tends to 0
therefore Pr[A_n models Gamma] tends to 1
boundaries: no countable intersection almost-sure closure claim
